AnalysisMetric.description:
Operations supported by the decision intelligence module.
Rejects arbitrary or unsupported queries.

Phase 2 additions:
- OVERVIEW: snapshot-level summary (encounters, images, cameras, time coverage).
- SPECIES_ENCOUNTER_COUNTS: deduplicated encounter/species contributions.
- CAMERA_COMPARISON: per-camera/site encounter and species counts.
- DAILY_ACTIVITY: encounter counts grouped by calendar date.
- HOURLY_ACTIVITY: encounter counts grouped by hour-of-day (0-23).
- SPECIES_CAMERA_MATRIX: species × camera count matrix.
- EFFORT_NORMALISED_RATES: encounters per active camera-day.
AnalysisMetric.title: AnalysisMetric

InclusionPolicy.description: Policy governing which detections are admitted into analytical aggregations.
InclusionPolicy.title: InclusionPolicy

description:
Phase 5 Request payload for activity anomaly indicators (Feature F12).
Compares recorded encounter activity for a focal species at a camera trap
against that camera's historical baseline.

CRITICAL INTERPRETATION:
Outputs are reviewable statistical indicators—not proof of population change,
migration, poaching, camera failure, or ecological causes.

baseline_start_time.description: Start of baseline historical time window (start-inclusive, timezone-aware).
baseline_start_time.title: Baseline Start Time

baseline_end_time.description: End of baseline historical time window (end-exclusive, timezone-aware).
baseline_end_time.title: Baseline End Time

evaluation_start_time.description: Start of evaluation time window (start-inclusive, timezone-aware).
evaluation_start_time.title: Evaluation Start Time

evaluation_end_time.description: End of evaluation time window (end-exclusive, timezone-aware).
evaluation_end_time.title: Evaluation End Time

analysis_timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier for day-bin boundaries and interval localization.
analysis_timezone.title: Analysis Timezone

species_ids.description: Optional list of focal species to evaluate. None evaluates all eligible species in scope.
species_ids.title: Species Ids

camera_ids.description: Optional list of camera IDs to evaluate. Each camera is evaluated as an independent series.
camera_ids.title: Camera Ids

site_ids.description: Optional list of site IDs to scope cameras.
site_ids.title: Site Ids

min_baseline_days.description: Minimum number of valid active baseline calendar days required for evaluation (default: 7).
min_baseline_days.title: Min Baseline Days

min_baseline_active_effort_days.description: Minimum total active baseline effort in camera-days required (default: 5.0).
min_baseline_active_effort_days.title: Min Baseline Active Effort Days

min_evaluation_active_effort_days.description: Minimum active evaluation effort in camera-days required (default: 1.0).
min_evaluation_active_effort_days.title: Min Evaluation Active Effort Days

min_day_coverage_ratio.description: Minimum fraction of the actual local calendar-day duration covered by active monitoring to qualify as a valid baseline day (default: 0.5 = 50% of local day, e.g. 12h on standard 24h days, 11.5h on 23h DST spring-forward days, 12.5h on 25h DST fall-back days).
min_day_coverage_ratio.title: Min Day Coverage Ratio

anomaly_threshold_sigmas.description: Number of normal-consistent MAD dispersions from baseline median required for anomaly alert (default: 3.0).
anomaly_threshold_sigmas.title: Anomaly Threshold Sigmas

min_absolute_rate_change.description: Minimum absolute rate change (encounters/active camera-day) required to prevent spurious micro-alerts (default: 0.2).
min_absolute_rate_change.title: Min Absolute Rate Change

allow_zero_dispersion_absolute_fallback.description: Whether to allow absolute threshold alerts when baseline dispersion MAD is zero.
allow_zero_dispersion_absolute_fallback.title: Allow Zero Dispersion Absolute Fallback

allow_suspect_comparability.description: Whether to evaluate anomaly indicators when stationarity is SUSPECT_OR_CHANGED. When False (default policy), series with suspected camera repositioning, model version changes, or deployment shifts are classified as NOT_EVALUABLE. When True, indicators are computed with explicit qualification warnings.
allow_suspect_comparability.title: Allow Suspect Comparability

inclusion_policy.description: Policy governing which detections within encounters are admitted.

expected_revision.description: Expected dataset revision for optimistic concurrency.
expected_revision.title: Expected Revision
